🏠 Fewer than 2 in 100 private rentals in Britain are affordable for someone on housing benefit — a £403 monthly shortfall on a typical two-bed home.

Citizens Advice helps over 100 renters a day with housing benefit problems, and foodbank referrals among them are up nearly 80% since 2021/22. Labour's Renters' Rights Act hasn't fixed the real problem.
